https://secure.itinio.com/otsego/ (the county's 'Click here for Reservations' link; a bot check, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: Non-Otsego County residents: 30-amp sites $30, 50-amp sites $35, 50-amp lake sites (29-39 odd) $40 a night; Otsego County residents pay $3 less ($27/$32/$37). A 4% reservation fee is added to every booking. Park entry needs a vehicle pass not included in the reservation: $5 a day or a $15 season pass (seniors 60+ $7, veterans and active military free). 30-day seasonal stays $625 (30-amp) or $730 (50-amp). Cabins $55-60 (deluxe from $95).

fees.source: https://www.otsegocountymi.gov/452/Otsego-Lake-County-Park ('Camping Fees (Nightly)': 30-amp sites 'Otsego County Residents: $27.00 per night Non-Otsego County Residents: $30.00 per night'; 50-amp '$32.00 ... $35.00'; 'Lake Sites 29, 31, 33, 35, 37, 39 (50-amp Service) ... $37.00 ... $40.00'; 'A 4% reservation fee is added to ALL campsite, cabin and pavilion reservations'; 'purchase a Season Pass for $15.00 or purchase a Day Pass for $5.00 per day'; seasonal 30 days $625/$730), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.otsegocountymi.gov/452/Otsego-Lake-County-Park ('80 modern campsites ... equipped with electricity'; rates by 30-amp/'50-amp service'; 'Each site has electrical service only and no water or sewer'; 'Camper Flush and Fill Station'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 80 modern campsites and four cabins (plus two deluxe cabins); sites 28-39 are 'vertical' sites where a trailer parks hitch-toward-the-road; lake sites are the odd numbers 29-39.

sites.source: https://www.otsegocountymi.gov/452/Otsego-Lake-County-Park ('27 acres containing 80 modern campsites and four cabins'; 'Campsites 28-39 are vertical campsites only'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Camper flush-and-fill station; firewood, ice and snacks at the ranger station; swim area, boat launch (vehicle permit required).

facilities.source: https://www.otsegocountymi.gov/452/Otsego-Lake-County-Park ('Restroom and Shower Facilities', 'Camper Flush and Fill Station', 'Firewood, Ice, Ice Cream and snacks are available for purchase'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book online through the county's Itinio page; seasonal sites (30-day blocks, up to about 150 days) by phone at 989-731-6448. Check-in 2pm, check-out 1pm.

booking.source: https://www.otsegocountymi.gov/452/Otsego-Lake-County-Park ('Click here for Reservations' -> secure.itinio.com/otsego/; 'To book a Seasonal Site, please call 989-731-6448'; 'Check-in time for campsites and cabins is 2:00 pm. Check-out time ... 1:00 pm'), read 2026-10-22

note: Otsego County park on Otsego Lake, about 5 mi south of Gaylord; swim area, boat launch, pavilions and cabins. Itinio booking reportedly takes a 2-night minimum (not stated on the county's pages). --Claude
